functional_requirements.description: User Authentication: Allow users to create accounts and log in/log out securely.
Plant Catalog Display: Display a catalog of plants with detailed information including name, image, description, price, size, care instructions (watering, sunlight, soil), and availability.
Plant Filtering: Enable users to filter plants based on various criteria such as plant type (e.g., indoor, outdoor, succulents), size, price range, sunlight requirements, and water needs.
Plant Search: Allow users to search for plants by name or keywords.
Add to Cart: Allow users to add selected plants to a virtual shopping cart.
Shopping Cart Management: Allow users to view, modify (increase/decrease quantity), and remove items from their shopping cart.
Checkout Process: Guide users through a secure checkout process including providing shipping address, selecting shipping options, and reviewing order summary.
Payment Integration: Integrate with secure payment gateways (e.g., Stripe, PayPal) to process online payments.
Order Management (User): Allow users to view their order history and track the status of their orders.
Admin Panel: Provide an admin panel to manage plant inventory (add, update, delete plants), manage orders, manage users, and configure website settings.
Inventory Management: Automatically update inventory levels after each purchase.
Shipping Options: Offer various shipping options with associated costs (e.g., standard, express, local pickup).
Tax Calculation: Automatically calculate and apply sales tax based on the shipping address.
Discounts and Promotions: Implement a system for creating and applying discounts and promotional codes.
Wishlist: Allow users to add plants to a wishlist for future purchase.
Customer Support: Integrate a customer support system (e.g., live chat, contact form) for users to ask questions and get assistance.
Email Notifications: Send automated email notifications for order confirmation, shipping updates, and account-related activities.
Reviews and Ratings: Allow users to leave reviews and ratings for plants.
Related Products: Suggest related plants based on the plant being viewed or in the cart.
Content Management System (CMS): Allow the admin to manage website content such as blog posts, FAQs, and about us page.

non_functional_requirements.description: Performance: The website should load quickly and respond to user actions in a timely manner (e.g., page load time < 3 seconds).

Security: The website should be secure and protect user data from unauthorized access and breaches.  Implement HTTPS, secure password storage, and protection against common web vulnerabilities (e.g., XSS, SQL injection).
Scalability: The website should be scalable to handle increasing traffic and data volume as the business grows.
Availability: The website should be available to users with minimal downtime (e.g., 99.9% uptime).
Usability: The website should be user-friendly and easy to navigate, with a clear and intuitive interface.
Responsiveness: The website should be responsive and adapt to different screen sizes and devices (desktops, tablets, mobile phones).
Maintainability: The website should be designed in a way that is easy to maintain and update.
Accessibility: The website should be accessible to users with disabilities, adhering to accessibility guidelines (e.g., WCAG).
SEO Friendly: The website should be designed to be search engine friendly to improve visibility in search results.
Data Privacy: The system must comply with all relevant data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA).
